researchEconomy.principle: Research is purchased once as an owner-authored product and may cross another settlement only by explicit sale or license; there is no ambient Union research pool.
flow: A news, operational, curriculum, analytics, or audience touchpoint induces a buyer-owned question or opportunity.
The buyer procures one bounded research product from a sovereign research shop and pays once for that product.
The product owner may sell exact reuse grants to a curriculum enterprise, Koios, an operating service, or another research team without rerunning the research.
A curriculum enterprise admits only the lesson-relevant product and owns prerequisite, competency, and correction placement—not the underlying research truth.
A persistent-notebook enterprise admits an exact licensed carrier into its own source corpus and buys one explainer transformation.
The channel buys the admitted lesson artifact, adds channel-owned framing and disclosure, then owns publication and audience effects.
Analytics observations are sold to an internal analytics broker; interpretations remain separately attributed research products and never rewrite source evidence.

notebookTopology.rule: Each new curriculum line receives a distinct persistent-notebook settlement and exact notebook identity to contain source limits, context contamination, corrections, and provider failure.
notebookTopology.sharedFaculty: All notebook settlements may independently hire urn:ame:notebooklm-inference-team under exact customer grants; they do not share credentials or source-state authority.
pending: provider standing grants extended to those two exact customers
